Report Description/// 10MAY24 48-HOUR PHMSA UPDATE TO NRC REPORT NUMBER 1398534 /// ON THURSDAY MAY 09 WILLIAMS CALLED THE NRC TO REPORT AN INCIDENT ON LINE2443 IN THE NW PIPELINE SYSTEM NEAR MILEPOST 112.5 IN WOLF CREEK, OREGON. THE INCIDENT OCCURRED DURING THE REMOVAL OF COATING ON THE PIPELINE WHILE COMPLETING AN EXPLORATORY DIG BASED ON AN ILI RUN. CAUSE OF THE LEAK IS CURRENTLY UNDER INVESTIGATION AND MORE INFORMATION WILL BE PROVIDED IN THE 30 DAY REPORT INCLUDING ESTIMATED LEAK VOLUME. THE LEAK WAS TEMPORARILY REMEDIATED WITH A PLIDCO LEAK CLAMP. THERE IS A PRESSURE REDUCTION ON THE LINE SINCE THE ONSET OF THE DIG CONSIDERED REPORTABLE DUE TO AN APPROXIMATE COST TO REPAIR OF $200,000. PERMANENT REPAIR BY CUTOUT IS EXPECTED TO BE COMPLETED 15JUN24. ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION OF INCIDENT: NATURAL GAS RELEASED FROM A 10 INCH PIPELINE THAT WAS FOUND DURING EXCAVATION WHEN THEY LOCATED AN ANOMALY.
